summary: The attacker staked the minimum 10 TRB on TellorFlex to become a reporter, then called submitValue to set the WALBT price to a massively inflated value. BonqDAO used instantaneous Tellor updates, so the attacker immediately deposited 0.1 WALBT and minted ~100M BEUR against it. They then reported a near-zero WALBT price to liquidate other users. PeckShield put the protocol loss at ~$120M; realized profit was ~$1.8M after laundering, bounded by on-chain liquidity.

price_series.note: WALBT ~$0.05 — real AllianceBlock token price, early Feb 2023

price_series.note: WALBT ~$5,000 — CONSERVATIVE lower-bound stand-in for the Tellor submitValue inflation (real magnitude derived from minting 100M BEUR against 0.1 WALBT was far larger, ~$1B/token)

notes: Polygon/Tellor attack ADAPTED to Soroban semantics. Pre-attack WALBT price is real (~$0.05). The manipulated price here is a CONSERVATIVE representative (5,000x) chosen for readable arithmetic — the on-chain Tellor value was orders of magnitude higher. Any move >20% trips ExcessiveDeviation, so the verdict is robust to the exact figure. Headline $120M is at-risk/protocol loss; realized profit ~$1.8M.
